title: ScenicCraft
description:
Beauty And Stable Frames For You
Credits: Built using Visualsmaxxing by Dimaxxing as a base, with additional custom mods and optimizations added for ScenicCraft. (Only in versions before 1.5.0!!)
body:
🌲 ScenicCraft: Minecraft, visually remastered. Experience the Minecraft feel with remastered shadows, lighting, clouds, and more! Made to run on less powerful computers with less processing and computing power. 

✨ Key Features: Breathtaking Terrain: Completely overhauled world generation featuring massive mountain ranges, deeper caverns, and realistic valleys. Mac & Laptop Optimized: Specially configured to deliver high-performance, playable FPS on devices that usually struggle with heavy modpacks. Vanilla Spirit: No confusing tech or magic mods to learn. The core gameplay remains the pure Minecraft you love, just infinitely more beautiful. lightweight Beauty: If your game can't run shaders at stable, playable fps, use the mod called "Shine" which adds beautiful features like colored lighting, while minimally impacting FPS!

🚀 Optimization Core: Scenic Craft drops outdated, heavy rendering engines in favor of modern, lightning-fast performance mods, like sodium. The gold standard for modern frame rate stabilization. 

Thank you for even noticing this modpack!
